stages.name: publish
stages.note: 12 concurrent publishers through appevents.Service.PublishEvent (validation, storage admission, outbox trigger, receipt); excludes HTTP auth middleware

stages.name: fanout
stages.note: back-to-back sweeps over a 200-event backlog; latency is per sweep (2 sweeps)

stages.name: drain
stages.note: claim, warm wake, gateway dispatch and completion over the routed backlog; dispatch concurrency production default; handler time 0 ms

stages.name: pipeline@20/s
stages.note: 20 s of offered load, publish to handler; fanout on event_published wakes plus a 5s safety tick; publishing took 20.0 s
